note: SHA-256 is computed over the canonical Git blob bytes (LF), not the working-tree bytes. On Windows with core.autocrlf the working-tree hash of an unmodified file will differ; use git status, not hash equality, to decide HEAD_IDENTICAL vs MODIFIED.
exclusions: node_modules/, .next/, out/, dist/, build/ dependency and build output
*.db, *.sqlite*, dump.rdb, *.parquet, minio_storage/, postgres_data/, backups/ runtime data
test-results/**/*.zip Playwright trace archives (734 MB, reproducible output); test-results XML/JSON/MD inventoried separately
local-evidence/ (Chat_HAND) inventoried separately as local evidence
